subject: general
question: What is the full form of the AI INSPIRED programme launched by Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre (IN-SPACe)?

options.text: Advanced Innovation for Space Propulsion, Intelligence and Research in Engineering Design
INnovating Space Performance with Intelligent Resilient Engines Development
Artificial Intelligence for Space Performance, Innovation and Research Development
INtegrated Space Programme for Research, Innovation and Data Engineering

solution:
The correct answer is __**Innovating Space Performance with Intelligent Resilient Engines Development.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre (IN-SPACe) has launched the AI INSPIRED programme to accelerate the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in India’s space sector.**
 
• The initiative aims to empower start-ups and MSMEs to develop AI-driven solutions for space missions and downstream applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Highlights of AI INSPIRED Programme__** 

__
 
• **Total Outlay:** ₹6 crore.
 
• **Funding Support:** Grant-in-aid of up to ₹1 crore per selected project.
 
• **Beneficiaries:** Up to six start-ups/MSMEs under the IN-SPACe Seed Fund Scheme.
 
• **Additional Support:** Mentorship, proposal development assistance, technical resources, and skill-building support.
 
• **Objective:** Align private-sector innovation with India’s long-term national space priorities.

 [IMAGE: //cdn.testbook.com/resources/lms_creative_elements/target.png] **Three Strategic Tracks under the Programme__** 

__
 
• **1. Edge Intelligence in Orbit:** AI-powered onboard systems for anomaly detection, power optimisation, predictive maintenance, and autonomous decision-making.
 
• **2. Space for Earth Intelligence:** AI-based satellite data analysis for precision agriculture, disaster management, climate monitoring, mineral mapping, and urban planning.
 
• **3. Smart Access to Space:** Innovations in launch logistics, satellite deployment, collision avoidance, and mission planning to enhance reliability and cost-efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Significance__** 

 
• Supports India’s growing private space ecosystem, which includes over 150 space start-ups.
 
• Enhances mission autonomy and reduces reliance on ground control systems.
 
• Strengthens disaster preparedness, national security, and data-driven governance.
 
• Aligns with global trends, as the space economy is projected to exceed $1 trillion by 2040.
 
• Reinforces India’s strategic vision to merge space technology with intelligent systems for societal benefit.
